_note: Copy to config.json (gitignored) and fill in. district picks a profile from config/districts/; any field set here overrides the profile. roster + students are real names — they belong ONLY in the local config.json, never in committed files.
students: ROTATION STUDENT NAMES — EXACTLY AS SHOWN IN VIEW STUDENTS

roster.name: STUDENT WHO MAY NOT APPEAR (other school)

_playlistNote: Optional ordered sequence per student, overriding mode/targetActivity when non-empty. Entries: {"mode":"movie"|"activity","target":"Exact Activity Name"} for one named item, or {"mode":"movie","count":5} for the first 5 in list order (activity entries skip anything at 100%; movies play regardless). Add "once":true to run an entry only for the FIRST student of the session — e.g. movies the whole group watches together. Example: [{"mode":"movie","count":5,"once":true},{"mode":"activity","target":"How to Greet Others"}]

teacherLed._note: enCORE Teacher-Led session setup. Runs via afterRotation:"teacherLed" or `npm start -- --teacher-led`. group takes precedence over students; empty group uses the students list. autoBegin:true clicks Begin Session itself — that starts a REAL logged session; false stops at the button and waits for you. encoreAppHash null = use the district profile's hash (slzusd: #/apps/encr); set a value here ONLY to override the profile.

studentLed._note: Not implemented yet — `npm start -- --student-led` prints the recon notes. --recon-goals walks to step 2 to check the IEP Goals lesson source.
